votes.motion: Close the public hearing on CRA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2024-25
votes.description: Closes the public hearing held to accept comment on the proposed second budget amendment for the CRA's FY2024-25 budget, which includes adjustments for property tax increment obligations, interlocal agreements, additional interest revenue, and correction of an accounting error.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 08 of 2024, approving the second amendment of the 2025 budget of the Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency
votes.description: Formally adopts the second budget amendment for FY2024-25, adjusting CRA budgets for property tax increment obligations, interlocal agreements, reimbursement agreements, agency operations, $4.8 million in additional interest revenue, and correction of a $1.8 million accounting error.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 09 of 2025, adopting the term sheet for financial assistance to NeighborWorks Salt Lake for the Maltair and Stanbridge Projects, including an exception for the Maltair Lanes waiving the Sustainability Development Policy threshold requirement for Emissions-Free Building Operation to enable use of natural gas for HVAC systems, while retaining the Enhanced Energy Performance requirement
votes.description: Approves $2.1 million in financial assistance to NeighborWorks Salt Lake for two affordable homeownership projects to be incorporated into a Community Land Trust, with a partial sustainability policy waiver allowing natural gas HVAC on the Maltair Lanes project while maintaining enhanced energy performance standards.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, and for attorney-client matters privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137
votes.description: Moves the CRA Board into a closed session to discuss real property transactions and privileged attorney-client matters as permitted under the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
Formally ends the closed session and returns the CRA Board meeting to open session.
